summary_en: Santen Pharmaceutical authorized acquisition of up to 16 million shares (5.0% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 35.0 billion yen through market purchases from November 6, 2026 to May 10, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Santen Pharmaceutical has authorized the acquisition of treasury shares in a single buyback program. The company is authorized to purchase up to 16 million ordinary shares, representing 5.0% of outstanding shares (321.8 million shares as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum aggregate amount of 35.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 6, 2026 through May 10, 2027, and purchases will be executed through market acquisitions using a discretionary trading method.

The company cites three objectives for this capital allocation decision: enhancing stable shareholder returns (which management identifies as among its most important priorities), further improving capital efficiency, and implementing flexible capital policies in response to business conditions and financial circumstances. Any treasury shares acquired under this authorization are expected to be cancelled pursuant to board resolutions under the Companies Act. Market conditions may result in partial non-execution of authorized purchases.
